def shipping_total(item_price, qty, ship_fee):
    return item_price * qty + ship_fee

total = shipping_total(9, 4, 5)
print(f"4 items + shipping = ${total}")

functions-and-modules.code:
tax = 0

def net_total(price, qty, tax):
    return price * qty - tax


cases = [(10, 2, 3, 17), (5, 4, 0, 20), (8, 1, 2, 6)]
correct = all(net_total(p, q, t) == exp for p, q, t, exp in cases)
globals()["tax"] = 99
pure = all(net_total(p, q, t) == exp for p, q, t, exp in cases)
print(f"correct: {correct}")
print(f"pure (survives a changed global): {pure}")
print(f"PASS: {correct and pure}")

control-flow.code:
def open_tickets(tickets):
    return [t for t in tickets if t["status"] == "open" and t["priority"] >= 2]


data = [
    {"id": 1, "status": "open", "priority": 3},
    {"id": 2, "status": "closed", "priority": 3},
    {"id": 3, "status": "open", "priority": 1},
    {"id": 4, "status": "open", "priority": 2},
]
ids = [t["id"] for t in open_tickets(data)]
ids2 = [t["id"] for t in open_tickets([
    {"id": 9, "status": "open", "priority": 5},
    {"id": 8, "status": "open", "priority": 1},
])]
print("kept ids:", ids)
print(f"PASS: {ids == [1, 4] and ids2 == [9] and len(data) == 4}")
